entries.source: Select the party member to receive the hexes generic talent tree:
entries.target: 选择接受邪术通用技能树的队伍成员：

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#  * You've found the needed %s.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#  * 你找到了所需要的%s。#WHITE#

entries.source: You were sent to the Charred Scar at the heart of which lies a huge volcano. In the Age of Pyre it destroyed the old Sher'Tul ruins that stood there, absorbing much of their latent magic.
entries.target: 你被送到了灼烧之痕，其中心是一座巨大的火山——烈火纪时，喷发的火山摧毁了当时矗立于此的古老夏·图尔遗址，并吸收了其中潜藏的大量魔法。

entries.source: You have heard that near the Charred Scar, to the south, lies a ruined tower known as the Dreadfell.
entries.target: 你听说在南方的灼烧之痕附近，有一座被称为恐惧王座的废弃高塔。

entries.source: Back and there again
entries.target: 归而复往

entries.source: You have created a portal back to Maj'Eyal. You should try to talk to someone in Last Hope about establishing a link back.
entries.target: 你创造了一个回到马基·埃亚尔的传送门，你应该试着去最后的希望找个人谈谈建立返回通路的事。

entries.source: You talked to the Elder in Last Hope who in turn told you to talk to Tannen, who lives in the north of the city.
entries.target: 你和最后的希望的长者交谈，得知要去找城市北边的泰恩。

entries.source: You gave the Orb of Many Ways to Tannen to study while you look for the athame and diamond in Reknor.
entries.target: 你把多元水晶球交给泰恩研究，自己则去瑞库纳寻找仪式匕首和共鸣钻石。

entries.source: You kept the Orb of Many Ways despite Tannen's request to study it. You must now look for the athame and diamond in Reknor.
entries.target: 尽管泰恩想要研究多元水晶球，你还是把它留在了自己手中。现在你必须去瑞库纳寻找仪式匕首和共鸣钻石。

entries.source: You brought back the diamond and athame to Tannen who asked you to check the tower of Telmur, looking for a text of portals, although he is not sure it is even there. He told you to come back in a few days.
entries.target: 你把共鸣钻石和仪式匕首带回给泰恩；他让你去泰尔玛之塔寻找一本有关传送门的典籍，尽管他也不确定那里是否真有。他让你过几天再回来。

entries.source: You brought back the diamond and athame to Tannen who asked you to contact Zemekkys to ask some delicate questions.
entries.target: 你把共鸣钻石和仪式匕首带回给泰恩；他让你联系泽梅基斯，询问一些敏感问题。

entries.source: You brought back the diamond and athame to Tannen who asked you to come back in a few days.
entries.target: 你把共鸣钻石和仪式匕首带回给泰恩；他让你过几天再回来。

entries.source: Tannen has tricked you! He swapped the orb for a false one that brought you to a demonic plane. Find the exit, and get revenge!
entries.target: 泰恩把你耍了！他用一个假水晶球掉了包，把你传送到了恶魔空间。找到出口，回去找他算账！

entries.source: Tannen revealed himself as the vile scum he really is and trapped you in his tower.
entries.target: 泰恩露出了真面目——他就是个卑鄙的人渣，他把你囚禁在他的塔牢里。

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* The portal to the Far East is now functional and can be used to go back.#WHITE#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 通向远东的传送门开始运作了，你可以用它来回去。#WHITE#

entries.source: Tannen points to the location of Telmur on your map.
entries.target: 泰恩在你的地图上指出了泰尔玛的位置。

entries.source: A portal appears in the center of the tower!
entries.target: 在塔的中间出现了一个传送门！

entries.source: Meranas, Herald of Angolwen
entries.target: 安格利文传令官 梅拉纳斯

entries.source: #VIOLET#You enter the swirling portal and in the blink of an eye you are back in Last Hope.
entries.target: #VIOLET#你进入了传送漩涡，一眨眼的功夫你已经回到了最后的希望。

entries.source: You successfully escorted the %s to the recall portal on level %s.
entries.target: 你成功地将%s护送到了%s的召回传送门。

entries.source: As a reward you %s.
entries.target: 作为奖励，你%s。

entries.source: You abandoned %s, to death.
entries.target: 你抛下了%s，任其死去。

entries.source: You failed to protect the %s from death by %s.
entries.target: 你未能保护%s，他被%s杀死了。

entries.source: Escort the %s to the recall portal on level %s.
entries.target: 将%s护送到%s的召回传送门。

entries.source: #LIGHT_RED#%s is dead, quest failed!
entries.target: #LIGHT_RED#%s 死了，任务失败了！

entries.source: something
entries.target: 某物

entries.source: Recall Portal
entries.target: 召回传送门

entries.source: %s of %s
entries.target: %s的第%s层

entries.source: Escort: %s (level %s)
entries.target: 护送：%s (%s)

entries.source: And now for a grave
entries.target: 绝望的坟墓

entries.source: Ungrol of Last Hope asked you to look for his wife's friend Celia, who has been reported missing. She frequently visits her late husband's mausoleum, in the graveyard near Last Hope.
entries.target: 最后的希望城的温格洛请你寻找他妻子的朋友赛利亚；据说她失踪了。赛利亚常去最后的希望附近墓地中她亡夫的陵墓。

entries.source: You searched for Celia in the graveyard near Last Hope, and found a note. In it, Celia reveals that she has been conducting experiments in the dark arts, in an attempt to extend her life... also, she is pregnant.
entries.target: 你在最后的希望附近的墓地寻找赛利亚，并发现了一张字条。字条中，赛利亚透露自己一直在研究黑暗法术，试图延长寿命……而且她怀孕了。

entries.source: You have tracked Celia to her husband's mausoleum in the graveyard near Last Hope. It seems she has taken some liberties with the corpses there.
entries.target: 你跟踪赛利亚，找到了她亡夫位于最后的希望附近墓地中的陵墓。看来她对那里的尸体做了些出格的事。

entries.source: You have laid Celia to rest, putting an end to her gruesome experiments.
entries.target: 你埋葬了赛利亚，终结了她阴森恐怖的实验。

entries.source: You have laid Celia to rest, putting an end to her failed experiments. You have taken her heart, for your own experiments. You do not plan to fail as she did.
entries.target: 你埋葬了赛利亚，终结了她失败的实验，你拿走了她的心脏为自己的实验做准备，你相信你不会重蹈她的覆辙。

entries.source: Falling Toward Apotheosis
entries.target: 坠向神化

entries.source: You have vanquished the masters of the Orc Pride. Now you must venture inside the most dangerous place of this world: the High Peak.
entries.target: 你击败了兽人部落的首领们，现在你必须向这个世界最危险的地方挺进：巅峰。

entries.source: Seek the Sorcerers and stop them before they bend the world to their will.
entries.target: 找到那些巫师，在他们让世界屈从于自己的意志之前阻止他们。

entries.source: To enter, you will need the four orbs of command to remove the shield over the peak.
entries.target: 想要进去的话，你必须找到那四个指令水晶球来移除峰顶的防护罩。

entries.source: The entrance to the peak passes through a place called 'the slime tunnels', probably located inside or near Grushnak Pride.
entries.target: 通往巅峰的入口要经过一个名为“史莱姆通道”的地方，它大概位于格鲁希纳克部落内部或附近。

entries.source: You have reached the summit of the High Peak, entered the sanctum of the Sorcerers and destroyed them, freeing the world from the threat of evil.
entries.target: 你已登上巅峰之巅，进入巫师们的圣所并消灭了他们，将世界从邪恶的威胁中解放出来。

entries.source: You have won the game!
entries.target: 你通关了！

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You encountered Sun Paladin Aeryn who blamed you for the loss of the Sunwall. You were forced to kill her.#LAST#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你遇到了太阳骑士艾琳；她将太阳堡垒的陷落归咎于你，你不得不杀了她。#LAST#

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You encountered Sun Paladin Aeryn who blamed you for the loss of the Sunwall, but you spared her.#LAST#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你遭遇了太阳骑士艾琳，她把太阳堡垒陷落的责任归咎在你的头上，但是你饶恕了她。#LAST#

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You defeated the Sorcerers before the Void portal could open.#LAST#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你在虚空传送门打开之前击败了那些巫师。#LAST#

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You defeated the Sorcerers and Aeryn sacrificed herself to close the Void portal.#LAST#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你击败了那些巫师，艾琳牺牲自己关闭了虚空传送门。#LAST#

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#* You defeated the Sorcerers and sacrificed yourself to close the Void portal.#LAST#
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#* 你击败了那些巫师，并牺牲了自己关闭虚空传送门。#LAST#

entries.source: Endgame
entries.target: 游戏结束

entries.source: #LIGHT_RED#As you enter the level you hear a familiar voice.
entries.target: #LIGHT_RED#当你进入这一层时，听到了一个熟悉的声音。

entries.source: #LIGHT_RED#Fallen Sun Paladin Aeryn: '%s YOU BROUGHT ONLY DESTRUCTION TO THE SUNWALL! YOU WILL PAY!'
entries.target: #LIGHT_RED#堕落太阳骑士艾琳：“%s 你只给太阳堡垒带来了毁灭！你会为此付出代价！”

entries.source: Ruins of the Gates of Morning
entries.target: 晨曦之门的废墟

entries.source: The Sunwall was destroyed while you were trapped in the High Peak.
entries.target: 当你在巅峰被困的时候，太阳堡垒被摧毁了。

entries.source: Winner
entries.target: 游戏胜利

entries.source: #GOLD#Well done! You have won the Tales of Maj'Eyal: The Age of Ascendancy#WHITE#
entries.target: #GOLD#干得好！你赢得了《马基·埃亚尔的传说：卓越纪》#WHITE#

entries.source: The Sorcerers are dead, and the Orc Pride lies in ruins, thanks to your efforts.
entries.target: 巫师们已经死去，兽人部落也沦为废墟，这都归功于你的努力。

entries.source: Your patron's plan worked. As your body was crushed by the raw forces of the void portal it opened wide. In an instant the connection was made and waves of heat came through.
entries.target: 你的庇护者的计划成功了。你的身体被虚空传送门的原始力量碾碎，传送门随之完全开启。连接转瞬建立，滚滚热浪从门中涌出。

entries.source: The mad sun brought forth all its power through the portal, turning the High Peak into a giant searing needle!
entries.target: 疯狂的太阳带着所有力量穿越了传送门，将巅峰化为一根灼烧的巨针！

entries.source: A few minutes later the whole world was set ablaze, nothing survived except Faeros elementals.
entries.target: 几分钟后，整个世界都被点燃，除了法罗元素，没有任何幸存者。

entries.source: In the aftermath of the battle the Distant Sun tried to force you to open the portal to bring it forth onto Eyal.
entries.target: 战斗结束后，遥远的太阳试图强迫你开启传送门，让它降临埃亚尔。

entries.source: Through an incredible display of willpower you resisted long enough to ask Aeryn to kill you.
entries.target: 你凭借惊人的意志力抵抗了足够久，终于得以请求艾琳杀死你。

entries.source: She sadly agreed and ran her sword through you, enabling you to do the last sacrifice you could for the world.
entries.target: 她怀着悲痛的心情用长剑刺穿了你的身躯，你终于为这个世界做出了最后的贡献。

entries.source: Through an incredible display of willpower you resisted for a few decisive seconds. During this time a Sher'tul appeared, took the Staff and killed you.
entries.target: 你以惊人的意志力抵抗了关键的数秒，夏·图尔人出现了，取走了法杖并杀死了你。

entries.source: Though you succumbed to the fight, your mind was already gone, burnt to ashes by your mad patron sun. But the world was saved.
entries.target: 虽然你在这场搏斗中倒下了，你的心智却早已被你那疯狂的太阳主上烧成灰烬。但世界得救了。

entries.source: Your sacrifice worked. Your mental energies were imbued with farportal energies. The Way radiated from the High Peak toward the rest of Eyal like a mental tidal wave.
entries.target: 你的牺牲起作用了，你的精神能量被远行传送门能量所灌注。维网从巅峰向埃亚尔各处辐射出一股精神冲击波。

entries.source: Every sentient being in Eyal is now part of the Way. Peace and happiness are enforced for all.
entries.target: 所有埃亚尔有知觉的生物都成为了维网的一部分，和平与幸福被强加于所有生物。

entries.source: Only the mages of Angolwen were able to withstand the mental shock and thus are the only unsafe people left. But what can they do against the might of the Way?
entries.target: 只有安格利文的法师能够抵制住这道精神冲击，从而他们成为了仅存的危险人类，不过他们又能对强大的维网怎么样呢？

entries.source: In the aftermath of the battle the Way tried to force you to act as a vessel to bring the Way to every sentient being.
entries.target: 在战斗结束后，维网试图强迫你充当载体，将维网带给所有知觉生物。

entries.source: You have prevented the portal to the Void from opening and thus stopped the Creator from bringing about the end of the world.
entries.target: 你阻止了虚空传送门的开启，并终止了世界末日的到来。

entries.source: In a selfless act, High Sun Paladin Aeryn sacrificed herself to close the portal to the Void and thus stopped the Creator from bringing about the end of the world.
entries.target: 高阶太阳骑士艾琳无私地牺牲了自己，关闭通往虚空的传送门，从而阻止造物主毁灭世界。

entries.source: In a selfless act, you sacrificed yourself to close the portal to the Void and thus stopped the Creator from bringing about the end of the world.
entries.target: 你无私地牺牲了自己，关闭通往虚空的传送门，从而阻止造物主毁灭世界。

entries.source: The Gates of Morning have been destroyed and the Sunwall has fallen. The last remnants of the free people in the Far East will surely diminish, and soon only orcs will inhabit this land.
entries.target: 晨曦之门已被摧毁，太阳堡垒已经陷落。远东自由人民最后的残余势力必将衰亡，不久后，这片土地上将只剩兽人。

entries.source: The orc presence in the Far East has greatly been diminished by the loss of their leaders and the destruction of the Sorcerers. The free people of the Sunwall will be able to prosper and thrive on this land.
entries.target: 随着首领丧生、巫师们被消灭，远东的兽人势力已大幅削弱。太阳堡垒的自由人民将得以在这片土地上繁衍兴盛。

entries.source: Maj'Eyal will once more know peace. Most of its inhabitants will never know they even were on the verge of destruction, but then this is what being a true hero means: to do the right thing even though nobody will know about it.
entries.target: 马基·埃亚尔将重归和平。大多数居民永远不会知道自己曾濒临毁灭，但这正是真正英雄的意义：即使无人知晓，也要做正确的事。

entries.source: You may continue playing and enjoy the rest of the world.
entries.target: 你可以继续在这个世界上探险。

entries.source: The Infinite Dungeon
entries.target: 无尽地下城

entries.source: You have entered the Infinite Dungeon. There is no going back now.
entries.target: 你进入了无限地下城。你已不能再走回头路了。

entries.source: Go deep, fight, win or die in a blaze of glory!
entries.target: 深入地下城去战斗吧，胜利或者为荣耀而死！
